description: Fetch content from a specified URL and return its contents in a readable markdown format. Use this tool when you need to retrieve and analyze web content.

url.description: The URL to fetch. The content will be converted to a readable markdown format.

requestSmartModeApproval.description: Set to true when immediately retrying the exact same fetch after Auto-review blocks it and you decide the user should approve it through the native approval card.

smartModeBlockReason.description: Provide the exact block reason returned by Auto-review in the prior rejection. Required when requestSmartModeApproval is true so the approval card shows the original classifier reason without re-running the classifier.
